description: This file implements a mouse input provider for the Kivy framework, handling mouse events, multitouch emulation, hover events, and configuration options specific to mouse input on Linux systems.

classes.name: MouseMotionEvent
classes.description: Represents a mouse motion event, capable of depacking data and updating graphics.

classes.name: MouseMotionEventProvider
classes.description: Provides mouse motion events, manages mouse input, multitouch emulation, hover events, and configuration options.

methods.name: depach
methods.description: Unpacks raw args into mouse event properties, including position, button, multitouch simulation, and modifiers.

methods.name: update_graphics
methods.description: Creates and updates visual representation of the mouse event on the screen.

methods.name: clear_graphics
methods.description: Removes the graphical representation of the mouse event.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MouseMotionEvent with default multitouch and modifiers.

methods.name: create_touch
methods.description: Creates a new touch event, optionally with graphics, and adds it to the active touches.

methods.name: remove_touch
methods.description: Removes a touch event from active touches and updates its end time.

methods.name: create_hover
methods.description: Creates or updates a hover event at the current mouse position.

methods.name: on_mouse_motion
methods.description: Handles mouse movement, updating current drag or creating new touches.

methods.name: on_mouse_press
methods.description: Handles mouse button press, initiating touches or drag events.

methods.name: on_mouse_release
methods.description: Handles mouse button release, finalizing or removing touches.

methods.name: update_touch_graphics
methods.description: Updates graphics for all active touches.

methods.name: begin_or_update_hover_event
methods.description: Starts or updates a hover event.

methods.name: begin_hover_event
methods.description: Starts a hover event.

methods.name: update_hover_event
methods.description: Updates the current hover event.

methods.name: end_hover_event
methods.description: Ends the current hover event.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the mouse input provider, binding event handlers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the mouse input provider, unbinding event handlers.

methods.name: _start_hover_events
methods.description: Binds hover-related events.

methods.name: _stop_hover_events
methods.description: Unbinds hover-related events.

methods.name: test_activity
methods.description: Checks if other touches are active to determine activity status.

methods.name: find_touch
methods.description: Finds an existing touch near given normalized coordinates.

methods.name: create_event_id
methods.description: Generates a unique event ID.
